name: list
title: List
description: Slot-based list row primitive. Leading slot accepts icon / avatar / checkbox / radio / switch; trailing slot accepts icon or control. Text supports 1 / 2 / 3 lines (Label · Title · Description) with auto items-start alignment for 3-line + image layouts. Optional interactive mode, divided variant, and a 56×56 ListAvatar helper. Pixel-perfect port of Figma node 3461:3 (Pantheon › List).
